description: Map the CUL3-KEAP1 interface from PDB 5NLB onto CACUL1 through the Smith-Waterman alignment and test whether the contact chemistry is conserved
code:
import json, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

W=os.getcwd()
seqs=json.load(open(os.path.join(W,'seqs.json')))
amap={int(k):v for k,v in json.load(open(os.path.join(W,'cacul1_cul3_map.json')))['pairs_cul3'].items()}
CUL3=seqs['CUL3']; CACUL1=seqs['CACUL1']
print('alignment block: CUL3',min(amap),'-',max(amap),'<-> CACUL1',min(amap.values()),'-',max(amap.values()))

p5=os.path.join(W,'5NLB.pdb')
if not os.path.exists(p5):
    open(p5,'w').write(requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/5NLB.pdb',timeout=180).text)
txt=open(p5).read()

three2one={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G',
 'HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T',
 'TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(t):
    ch={}
    for l in t.split('\n'):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')):
            rn=l[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in three2one: continue
            c=l[21]; ri=int(l[22:26])
            ch.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault(ri,{'aa':three2one[rn],'atoms':[]})['atoms'].append(
                (float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
    return ch
ch=parse(txt)
for c,v in sorted(ch.items()):
    print(f'chain {c}: {len(v)} res  {min(v)}-{max(v)}')

def frac(v,ref):
    h=t=0
    for ri,d in v.items():
        if 1<=ri<=len(ref): t+=1; h+=(ref[ri-1]==d['aa'])
    return (h/t if t else 0), t
cul3c=[]; partn=[]
for c,v in sorted(ch.items()):
    f,t=frac(v,CUL3); print(f'chain {c}: CUL3-numbering identity {f:.2f} over {t}')
    (cul3c if (f>0.8 and t>50) else partn).append(c)
print('CUL3 chains',cul3c,'| partner chains',partn)

def contacts(A,B,cut=4.5):
    Bx=np.array([x for ri in B for x in B[ri]['atoms']])
    out=set()
    for ri,d in A.items():
        P=np.array(d['atoms'])
        if np.sqrt(((P[:,None,:]-Bx[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min()<cut: out.add(ri)
    return out

kc=set()
for a in cul3c:
    for b in partn:
        kc |= contacts(ch[a],ch[b])
print('\nCUL3 residues within 4.5 A of a partner chain in 5NLB:',len(kc))
print(sorted(kc))

rows=[{'CUL3_pos':r,'CUL3_aa':CUL3[r-1],'in_CACUL1_block':r in amap,
       'CACUL1_pos':amap.get(r),'CACUL1_aa':CACUL1[amap[r]-1] if r in amap else None,
       'identical':(r in amap and CUL3[r-1]==CACUL1[amap[r]-1])} for r in sorted(kc)]
mt=pd.DataFrame(rows); mt.to_csv(os.path.join(W,'table_cul3_KEAP1_interface_5NLB_mapped_to_CACUL1.csv'),index=False)
print(); print(mt.to_string(index=False))

n_tot=len(mt); n_in=int(mt['in_CACUL1_block'].sum()); n_id=int(mt['identical'].sum())
iface=set(mt.loc[mt['in_CACUL1_block'],'CUL3_pos'])
bg_id=sum(1 for k,v in amap.items() if CUL3[k-1]==CACUL1[v-1]); bg_n=len(amap)
non_id=sum(1 for k,v in amap.items() if k not in iface and CUL3[k-1]==CACUL1[v-1]); non_n=bg_n-n_in
orr,pv=fisher_exact([[n_id,n_in-n_id],[non_id,non_n-non_id]])
print(f'\nKEAP1-contacting CUL3 residues falling inside the CACUL1-aligned block: {n_in}/{n_tot}')
print(f'identical there: {n_id}/{n_in} = {n_id/max(n_in,1):.1%}')
print(f'identical elsewhere in block: {non_id}/{non_n} = {non_id/max(non_n,1):.1%}')
print(f'whole-block background: {bg_id}/{bg_n} = {bg_id/bg_n:.1%}')
print(f'Fisher OR={orr:.2f}, p={pv:.3f}')
json.dump({'n_keap1_contacts':n_tot,'n_in_block':n_in,'n_identical':n_id,
           'iface_identity':n_id/max(n_in,1),'other_identity':non_id/max(non_n,1),
           'block_background':bg_id/bg_n,'fisher_OR':orr,'fisher_p':pv},
          open(os.path.join(W,'keap1_interface_mapping.json'),'w'),indent=1)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.0))
ax[0].barh(0,768,color='#dfe6ee',edgecolor='#8a97a6',height=0.34)
ax[0].text(772,0,'CUL3\n1-768',va='center',fontsize=8)
ax[0].barh(0,max(amap)-min(amap)+1,left=min(amap),color='#4878a8',height=0.34)
ax[0].annotate(f'aligned to CACUL1\nCUL3 {min(amap)}-{max(amap)}',xy=(80,0.20),xytext=(60,0.62),
               fontsize=8,color='#27496d',ha='center')
k=sorted(kc)
ax[0].scatter(k,[-0.38]*len(k),marker='|',s=260,color='#c0392b',linewidths=1.3)
ax[0].text(230,-0.56,f'KEAP1 contacts in 5NLB (n={n_tot}); {n_in} fall inside the aligned block',
           fontsize=8,color='#c0392b')
ax[0].axvline(383,color='#2d6a4f',ls=':'); ax[0].text(388,0.76,'CHD 383-635',fontsize=8,color='#2d6a4f')
ax[0].axvline(712,color='#7b3f99',ls=':'); ax[0].text(600,-0.84,'K712 NEDD8 site',fontsize=8,color='#7b3f99')
ax[0].set_ylim(-1,1); ax[0].set_yticks([]); ax[0].set_xlim(0,880); ax[0].set_xlabel('CUL3 residue')
ax[0].set_title('A  CACUL1 matches the adaptor-binding end of CUL3 only',loc='left',fontsize=11)

vals=[n_id/max(n_in,1)*100, non_id/max(non_n,1)*100]
b=ax[1].bar(['KEAP1-contact\npositions','other aligned\npositions'],vals,color=['#c0392b','#4878a8'],width=0.5)
for bb,v,n in zip(b,vals,[n_in,non_n]):
    ax[1].text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,v+1.2,f'{v:.0f}%  (n={n})',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel('CACUL1 residue identical to CUL3 (%)'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,55)
ax[1].set_title(f'B  Contact chemistry is not conserved\nFisher OR={orr:.2f}, p={pv:.2f}',loc='left',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
